name: turborel
description: The JavaScript driver for turborel, a relational database system: its native protocol in TypeScript, for Node.js, with no runtime dependencies. Its version is the turborel release it is made for; the alpha, 0.0.0, speaks protocol version 1.
author: Turborel Inc.

scripts.rm: node -e "const fs = process.getBuiltinModule('node:fs'); for (const d of process.argv.slice(1)) fs.rmSync(d, { recursive: true, force: true })"
scripts.clean: npm run rm -- build dist coverage
scripts.build: npm run rm -- dist && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
scripts.build:test: npm run rm -- build && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json
scripts.test: npm run build:test && node build/tools/check.js && node --test --test-concurrency=1 "build/test/**/*.test.js"
scripts.examples: npm run build && npm run build:test && node build/tools/examples.js
scripts.verify: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run test
scripts.prepack: npm run clean && npm run build
